blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Communicating with the public during an emergency entails issuing warning messages promptly. In Europe, it often requires producing them in more than one language. Recent work has shown that language models can be trained to generate warning messages as a crisis unfolds, but the available data covers only English. To fill this gap, we present CrisiLangs, a multilingual extension of CrisiText (an English dataset of crisis events paired with warning messages written according to expert communication guidelines) to Italian, Bulgarian, German, and Greek. Expert native speakers translated the warning messages of 1,000 events drawn from 411 scenarios, for a total of 5,000 event-message pairs across five languages. We test the resource to fine-tune a multilingual model on all five languages jointly, with and without the emergency guidelines in the prompt, and compare it with a zero-shot baseline. The fine-tuned models outperform the baseline on ROUGE-L, BLEU and BERTScore in every language and configuration. In a human preference study, low decoding temperatures receive the most preferences in all five languages and in both configurations, while the effect of the guidelines varies by language.
blocks.zh: 在紧急情况下与公众沟通需要迅速发布警告信息。 在欧洲,它常常需要用一种以上语言制作. 最近的工作表明,随着危机的发生,可以培训语言模型生成警告信息,但现有数据只涵盖英语。 为了填补这一空白,我们向意大利、保加利亚、德国和希腊介绍CrisiText(危机事件的英文数据集,加上根据专家通信准则编写的警告信息)。 本地专家演讲者翻译了从411场情景中提取的1 000个事件的警告信息,共计5 000个事件信息对5种语言。 我们测试资源,对所有五种语言的多语种模式进行精细调整,同时迅速制定和不制定应急指导方针,并与零镜头基线进行比较。 微调模型在每种语言和配置上都超过了ROUGE-L、BLEU和BERTScore的基线。 在一项人类偏好研究中,低解码温度在所有五种语言和两种配置中都得到最多的偏好,而准则的效果则因语言而异.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Timely and effective communication is a critical aspect of crisis management: during an emergency, authorities must inform the population about what is happening and about what to do, and they must do it repeatedly as the situation evolves. This has to be done under time pressure and the volume of information handled during an event is a recognized source of stress for emergency operators Misra et al. (2020) .
The issue is even worse in Europe, where nations are linguistically diverse (and many have multiple official languages) and there is a high cross-border mobility.
Therefore, warnings issued in a single language can fail to reach part of the population they are meant to protect. Issuing the same alert in several languages, at the speed an emergency requires, complicates the work of operators. Recent advances in Artificial Intelligence, and in particular Large Language Models (LLMs), which can interpret and produce text, offer a way to support this task Foubert et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh:
及时而有效的沟通是危机管理的一个关键方面:在紧急情况下,当局必须让人民了解正在发生的事情和应做什么,而且他们必须随着局势的发展反复这样做。 这项工作必须在时间压力下进行,而且事件期间处理的信息量是紧急情况操作人员Misra等人(2020年)公认的压力源。
这一问题在欧洲更为严重,因为欧洲各国语言多样(许多国家有多种官方语言),跨界流动频繁。
因此,以一种语言发出的警告可能无法到达他们要保护的部分人口。 以紧急情况所需的速度以几种语言发出同样的警报,使操作员的工作复杂化。 最近人工智能的进步,特别是能够解释和生成文本的"大语言模型"(LLMs),提供了一种支持这一任务的方法Foubert等 (2026).

blocks.en:
Crisis NLP has largely worked on analyzing text produced by users, with tasks such as detecting events in social media feeds and extracting informative content Olteanu et al. (2014) ; Alam et al. (2021) , but recent work has also studied how to use LLMs to assist operators in writing warning messages for ongoing crises.
For instance, the CrisiText dataset Gonella et al. (2026a) contains crisis scenarios as chronological chains of events, each paired with a warning message.
blocks.zh:
Crisis NLP主要致力于分析由用户制作的文本,任务包括检测社交媒体中的事件并提取信息内容 Olteanu等人(2014年);Alam等人(2021年),但最近的工作也研究了如何使用LLMS协助操作人员为正在发生的危机写出警告信息.
例如,CrisiText数据集Gonella等人(2026年a)将危机情景作为时间顺序事件链,每集都配有警告信息。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Workflow for the creation of CrisiLangs . Event descriptions and FEMA guidelines are machine-translated into each target language, while the warning messages are translated and adapted by a native speaker.
blocks.zh: 图1:创建CrisiLangs的工作流程 事件描述和FEMA准则被机器翻译为每种目标语言,而警告信息则由本地人翻译并改编.

blocks.en:
Existing resources and related models such as CrisiText focus only on English.
Multilingual coverage in crisis Natural Language Generation (NLG) has been addressed separately as a translation problem, by applying domain-adapted machine translation to existing crisis text Staiano et al. (2025) ; Castaldo et al. (2026) . Crisis content, however, is sensitive to automatic translation. Ticona and Anastasopoulos (2026) report lower quality for low-resource languages and when translating out of English.
One way to avoid sending automatically translated content to civilians would be to generate messages directly in the target language. However, to the best of our knowledge, no comparable training resource is available for languages other than English.
blocks.zh:
CrisiText等现有资源和相关模式只关注英语.
危机自然语言生成(NLG)中的多语种覆盖作为一个翻译问题被单独解决,具体做法是对现有危机文本Staiano等(2025);Castaldo等(2026)应用了适合域名的机器翻译. 然而,危机内容对自动翻译很敏感。 Ticona和Anastasopoulos(2026年)报告说,低资源语言和英语翻译的质量较低。
避免向平民发送自动翻译内容的一种方法是直接用目标语言发送信息。 然而,据我们所知,除英语外,没有其他语言的可比培训资源。

blocks.en:
To address this gap, we present CrisiLangs 1 1 1 The dataset can be found at https://huggingface.co/datasets/LanD-FBK/CrisiLangs , a multilingual extension of CrisiText including Italian, Bulgarian, German, and Greek, chosen to cover different writing systems and alphabets.
In collaboration with crisis communication experts we manually translated a subset of the CrisiText dataset into their native languages. The subsample covers 1,000 events from 411 crisis scenarios for a total of 5,000 event-message pairs across the five languages.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这一空白,我们提出CrisiLangs 11 1 数据集可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/LanD-FBK/CrisiLangs上找到,这是CrisiText的多语种扩展,包括意大利语、保加利亚语、德语和希腊语,被选用于涵盖不同的书写系统和字母。
我们与危机传播专家合作,手动将CrisiText数据集的子集翻译成他们的母语。 子样本涵盖来自411个危机情景的1000个事件,共计5000个事件信息对五种语言.

blocks.en:
We then use the resource to jointly fine-tune a multilingual model on all five languages in two configurations: with and without the emergency guidelines in the prompt. We tested the two configurations in two ways.
First, we evaluate the generations with automatic metrics at five decoding temperatures, with a zero-shot model used as the baseline. Since warning messages have to follow specific communication and behavioral guidelines, we varied the temperature to assess which level of lexical variation is best suited to the task. Second, to assess the quality of the generations, we asked native speakers to evaluate them in all five languages.
blocks.zh:
然后,我们利用资源对所有五种语言的多语种模式进行联合微调,分为两种配置:即时使用和不使用应急指南。 我们以两种方式测试了两种配置.
首先,我们用5个解码温度的自动度量衡来评估这几代人,以零发模型作为基线。 由于警告信息必须遵循具体的沟通和行为准则,我们改变了温度,以评估何种程度的词汇变化最适合这项任务。 第二,为了评估各代人的质量,我们请讲土著语言的人用所有五种语言对他们进行评估。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Most NLP work on crises relies on social media data, and the resulting resources are designed for classification and information extraction rather than automatic generation Imran et al. (2015) ; D. Lewis et al. (2025) . Datasets of user-created content collected during floods, earthquakes or tornadoes Olteanu et al. (2014) ; Imran et al. (2016) are annotated for informativeness, crisis detection or crisis type recognition, and are used to train classifiers Alam et al. (2021) ; Liu et al. (2021) . Fewer resources cover languages other than English: HumSet Fekih et al. (2022) provides humanitarian response documents in English, French and Spanish, and Kawarith Alharbi and Lee (2021) collects Arabic crisis tweets. Relatedly, Sánchez et al. (2023) study the cross-lingual transfer of classifiers trained on English crisis data to Spanish and Italian, and Vitiugin and Purohit (2024) detect and rank help requests posted in English, Spanish and Turkish during natural disasters.
blocks.zh: NLP大部分关于危机的工作依赖于社交媒体数据,由此产生的资源被设计用于分类和信息提取,而不是自动生成Imran等 (2015年); D. Lewis等 (2025年). 洪水、地震或龙卷风期间收集的用户创建内容数据集 Olteanu等人(2014年);Imran等人(2016年)因提供信息、发现危机或识别危机类型而备注,并用于培训分类人员。 Alam等 (2021); 刘等 (2021). 涵盖英语以外的语言的资源较少:HumSet Fekih等(2022年)以英语,法语和西班牙语提供人道主义应急文件,而Kawarith Alharbi和Lee(2021年)收集了阿拉伯危机推文. 与此相关的是,Sánchez等人(2023年)研究将接受过英语危机数据培训的分类人员跨语言转移至西班牙语和意大利语,而Vitiugin和Purohit(2024年)在自然灾害期间检测并排出英文、西班牙文和土耳其语的帮助请求。

blocks.en: Crisis NLP does, however, include generation, mainly in the form of summarization. The CrisisFACTS track McCreadie and Buntain (2023) recasts disaster response as the production of fact-based daily summaries from social media and news, and recent systems address it by combining retrieval with instruction-following LLMs Seeberger and Riedhammer (2024) . A related line works at the level of the individual emergency call, extracting the relevant information and presenting it to the call-taker Otal et al. (2024) . In both cases the output supports the response effort and is derived from text that already exists. Warning messages, on the other hand, are directly addressed to the population, and they are not produced by recapping existing textual reports.
blocks.zh: 然而,NLP危机确实包括了世代,主要表现为归纳. CrisisFACTS追踪了McCreadie和Buntain(2023年),将救灾重制为制作来自社交媒体和新闻的基于事实的每日摘要,而最近的系统通过将检索与跟随指令的LLMs Seeberger和Riedhammer(2024年)合并处理. 有一条相关线路在个别紧急呼叫的级别工作,取出相关信息并提交呼叫者Otal等(2024). 在这两种情况下,产出都支持响应努力,并且来自已经存在的文本。 另一方面,警告信息是直接针对民众的,而不是通过收回现有的文字报告来制作的。

blocks.en: How to reach speakers of different languages during an emergency has been studied in translation research under the name of crisis translation O’Brien and Federici (2019) , which looks at language needs in disaster settings and at how translation can be included in emergency planning. In NLP, the same problem has been approached as machine translation. Staiano et al. (2025) evaluate general-purpose LLM and NMT systems on Italian civil protection texts, while Castaldo et al. (2026) fine-tune a small model for crisis-domain translation to produce simplified English output, proposed as a “lingua franca” when full multilingual coverage is not feasible. This transfer is not uniformly reliable: Ticona and Anastasopoulos (2026) evaluate MT systems and LLMs on crisis-domain data in 30 languages and report substantial quality degradation, particularly for low-resource languages and in the direction from English into other languages.
blocks.zh: 在危机翻译O'Brien和Federici(2019年)的翻译研究中,研究了在紧急情况下如何接触不同语言的讲者,该研究探讨了灾害情况下的语言需要以及如何将翻译纳入应急规划。 在NLP中,机器翻译也遇到同样的问题. 施塔亚诺等. (2025年)对意大利平民保护文本的通用LLM和NMT系统进行评价,而Castaldo等人则评价. (2026) 微调一个小型的危机领域翻译模式,以产生简化的英文产出,在全多语种覆盖不可行时作为"语言"被提议. 这一转移并不统一可靠:Ticona和Anastasopoulos(2026年)用30种语言对MT系统和LLMs进行危机领域数据评价,并报告质量严重退化,特别是低资源语言,以及从英语转向其他语言。

blocks.en: Finally, a different line of work addresses the production of the message itself. The setting differs from the translation work described above, which starts from existing crisis text and moves it into another language. CrisiText Gonella et al. (2026a) pairs chronologically ordered crisis events with English warning messages written according to crisis guidelines, and has been used to fine-tune LLMs for message generation and post-editing. Other work addresses different communication settings: Hong et al. (2025) generate replies to individual social media posts in which affected people express their needs. Guidance can also be grounded in the spatial layout of the affected area: Gonella et al. (2026b) benchmark vision-language models on the generation of narrowcast guidance, i.e. guidance tailored to the individual civilian, in a simulated evacuation environment. These works produce messages in English, leaving the task in other languages unexplored.
blocks.zh: 最后,另一行工作涉及信息本身的制作。 设置与上述翻译工作不同,翻译工作从现有的危机文本起步,并移动到另一种语言. CrisiText Gonella等 (2026a) 将按时间顺序排列的危机事件与按照危机指南编写的英语警告信息相配,并被用来微调LLMS,用于消息生成和编辑后. 其他作品涉及不同的交流环境:Hong等. (2025年)生成对个别社交媒体帖子的回复,其中受影响的人表达自己的需要. 指导还可以建立在受影响地区的空间布局上:Gonella等(2026b)基准视觉语言模型,用于在模拟疏散环境中生成狭播指导,即针对平民个人的指针. 这些作品以英语制作信息,使得其他语言的任务没有被探讨.

blocks.en: 3 Multilingual Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 多种语言数据集

blocks.en:
Training an LLM to produce warning messages requires event-message data pairs. In order to address the task in a multilingual setting, we built CrisiLangs by extending the English CrisiText data.
Specifically, we used a manually curated subset of the original dataset and had its warning messages translated into Italian, Bulgarian, German, and Greek by four expert native speakers, one for each language.
The four languages were selected to ensure diversity in writing systems and language families, including three scripts
(Latin, Cyrillic and Greek) and four European language families (Romance, Slavic, Germanic and Hellenic). Figure 1 shows the workflow used to create the dataset.
blocks.zh:
培训一个 LLM 生成警告信息需要事件消息数据对等. 为了在多语种环境下处理这项任务,我们通过扩展英语CrisiText数据,建立了CrisiLangs.
具体地说,我们使用了一个手动整理的原始数据集的子集,并由四名当地专家将它的警告信息翻译成意大利语、保加利亚语、德语和希腊语,每种语言各一个。
选择这四种语言是为了确保书写系统和语言家族的多样性,包括三个脚本
(拉丁语、西里尔语和希腊语)和四个欧洲语言家庭(罗姆斯语、斯拉夫语、日耳曼语和希腊语)。 图1显示用于创建数据集的工作流程.

blocks.en: CrisiText Gonella et al. (2026a) contains more than 100,000 event-message pairs, where each event is labeled with one or more crisis categories (e.g., attack, flood or tornado). The messages were synthetically generated with an LLM following expert guidelines on communicative tone Sutton and Kuligowski (2019) and the behavioral guidance of the corresponding crisis categories, extracted from the official FEMA website. 2 2 2 https://www.ready.gov/ Events are also grouped into scenarios , in the form of chronological chains of events describing the unfolding of a single crisis, and each scenario is entirely contained in one of the original training, development, and test splits.
blocks.zh: CrisiText Gonella等 (2026a)包含有超过10万个事件信息对,其中每个事件被标注为一个或多个危机类别(如攻击,洪水或龙卷风等). 这些讯息是按关于交流基调Sutton和Kuligowski的专家准则(2019年)和从FEMA官方网站摘录的相应危机类别的行为指导合成的。 2 2 2 https://www.ready.gov/ 事件还被归为各种情景,按时间顺序排列,描述单一危机的发展,而每种情景都完全包含在最初的培训、发展和测试划分中。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Example of event and warning message from CrisiLangs in the five languages. The English event and message are the originals from CrisiText . In the other four languages the messages are human translations produced by native speakers, while the events are machine-translated.
blocks.zh: 图 2: CrisiLangs以五种语言发送的事件和警告信息示例. 英文事件及讯息为CrisiText的原文. 在其他四种语言中,信息是讲母语的人文翻译,而活动是用机器翻译的。

blocks.en: Table 1: Distribution of the event and message main categories over the 1,000 selected elements, grouped into human-caused and natural crises.
blocks.zh: 表1:按人为和自然危机划分的1 000个选定要素中的活动和信息主要类别分布情况。

blocks.en:
As part of the data quality assessment of CrisiText , two crisis communication experts reviewed a sample of 1,000 event-message pairs, balanced between human-caused and natural disasters.
We built our multilingual extension on this expert-reviewed sample. The pairs were drawn from the original training, development, and test splits in an 80/10/10 proportion.
Table 1 reports the distribution of message and event categories. Events can carry multiple labels: the table reports only the main category of each event, i.e. the first label listed for its scenario, and omits the remaining labels assigned to the same scenario. The sample is balanced by construction, with 500 human-caused and 500 natural events.
blocks.zh:
作为CrisiText数据质量评估的一部分,两名危机传播专家审查了1000个事件信息对样本,在人为灾害和自然灾害之间保持平衡。
我们在这个专家审查的样本上建立了我们的多语种扩展。 双人取自于最初的训练,开发,测试分出的比例为80/10/10.
表1汇报了信息和活动类别的分布情况。 事件可以带有多个标签:表格只报告每个事件的主要类别,即列出其情景的第一个标签,并省略了分配给同一情景的剩余标签. 样本由建筑平衡而来,有500起由人引起的事件和500起自然事件.

blocks.en: Table 2: Mean warning message length in characters per language in CrisiLangs .
blocks.zh: 表2: CrisiLangs 中每个语言的字符平均警告信息长度。

blocks.en:
The subsample was given to four native speakers, one per target language (details about them are reported in Appendix C ). Each translator received the original description of the event (both in English and automatically translated into their own language) and its associated warning message in English.
The FEMA guidelines used to generate the warning messages in CrisiText were also automatically translated. 3 3 3 The translation was done with GOOGLETRANSLATE API. Translators were asked to render the English message in their own language and to adapt it where necessary so that it would sound more natural and well formed. 4 4 4 Translators were allowed to use machine translation tools as support, provided that they revised the output. In both the messages and the guidelines we replaced the US emergency number “9-1-1” with the European one, “112”, since the target audience is European. This localized version of the guidelines is also the one used at training and generation time (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh:
分样本提供给了4名母语者,每个目标语言各1名(详情见附录C)。 每名翻译员都收到了关于事件的原始描述(既有英文,也有自动被翻译成自己语言)及其相关的英文警告信息.
用于生成 CrisiText 警告信息的FEMA 指南也被自动翻译出. 3 3 3 翻译是与GOGLETRANSLATE API完成的. 要求翻译者用自己的语言制作英文信息,并在必要时加以修改,使其听起来更加自然和完善。 4 4 4名笔译员获准使用机器翻译工具作为支助,条件是他们修改了产出。 在信息和指导方针中,我们把美国紧急电话号码“9-1-1”改为欧洲号码“112”,因为目标受众是欧洲人。 准则的这一地方化版本也是培训和生成时间使用的准则(第4节)。

blocks.en:
Human translation was limited to the warning messages. This was a deliberate design choice: the message is what the model has to produce and what the human evaluation judges, whereas the event description and the guidelines only enter as input. Translation noise on the input side is therefore less critical, and it reflects a realistic deployment setting, where the input is processed automatically. Translators could rely on the English source in case of doubt.
In total, we obtained 5,000 event-message pairs (1,000 per language, including English), from 411 unique scenarios. Figure 2 shows one such pair in all five languages, with the machine-translated event alongside the human-translated message.
These parallel versions differ slightly in length, with per-language mean lengths reported in Table 2 .
blocks.zh:
人的翻译仅限于警告信息。 这是一个有意的设计选择:信息是模型必须制作什么,以及人的评价判断什么,而事件描述和准则仅作为投入输入。 因此,输入一侧的翻译噪音不太重要,它反映了一种现实的部署环境,即自动处理输入. 如有疑问,翻译人员可以依赖英文来源。
我们总共从411种独特的情景中获得了5000个事件信息对(每种语言1,000个,包括英语). 图2以所有五种语言显示一对这样的一对,机器翻译事件与人翻译的信息一起出现。
这些平行版本的长度略有不同,每个语文的平均长度见表2。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Design
blocks.zh: 4 实验设计

blocks.en: We used the dataset to fine-tune a model in two configurations and to establish a zero-shot baseline for comparison. In order to assess which settings produce the most appropriate warning messages and how generation quality changes across the different languages, the generations were evaluated with automatic metrics and with a human preference study. The aim is to give future work on the resource a benchmark to compare against.
blocks.zh: 我们用数据集对两种配置的模型进行了微调,并建立了用于比较的零镜头基线. 为了评估哪些设置产生最适当的警告信息,以及不同语言的生成质量如何变化,用自动测量和人类偏好研究来评价这些世代。 目的是为今后关于资源的工作提供一个基准,以便进行比较。

blocks.en:
Following the original CrisiText work, we fine-tuned a single model, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct , with LoRA Hu et al. (2021) , keeping the same hyperparameters. To allow comparison with it we also kept the original prompt template (Figure 3 ), in which the instructions are in English while the events description are in the target language. In a preliminary zero-shot check we observed that the model consistently produced the warning message in the language of the input, so we did not add any explicit indication of the output language to the template.
In particular, each training instance contains an event description to be used as the basis for the warning message, plus the preceding events description to be used as context.
The message is generated only for the last event of the sequence.
Training was performed jointly across all five languages using a single multilingual model, rather than separate models for each language, with the aim of simplifying deployment in real-world settings.
blocks.zh:
在最初的CrisiText工作之后,我们微调了单一型号"Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct",与Lora Hu等 (2021)保持了相同的超参数. 为了与它进行比较,我们还保留了原始的即时模板(图3 ),其中的指令是英文,而事件描述是目标语言. 在一次初步的零镜头检查中,我们观察到模型始终用输入语言发出警告信息,因此我们没有在模板中加入任何输出语言的明显表示.
特别是,每个培训实例都包含一个事件描述,作为警告信息的依据,加上前述事件描述,作为上下文使用。
消息只为序列的最后一个事件生成.
在所有五种语文中联合开展培训,使用单一多语种模式,而不是每种语文的单独模式,目的是简化在现实环境中的部署。

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Prompt example. The instruction is always in English, while [EVENTS] is replaced by the chain of events of the instance, in its language, with the target event as its last line.
The segments marked with † appear only in the +guidelines configuration, where [GUIDELINES] is replaced by the translated FEMA guidelines of the crisis categories of the event.
blocks.zh:
图3:迅速的例子。 指令总是以英语为主,而[EVENTS]则被实例的一连串事件所取而代之,用其语言,以目标事件为最后一行.
标有 Q 的片段只出现在 + 指针配置中,其中 [GUIDELINES] 被该事件危机类别翻译的 FEMA 指针所取代.

blocks.en: We trained the model in two configurations. In the plain setup, the user prompt contains only the event descriptions. On the other hand, in the +guidelines setup, the prompt additionally contains the translated FEMA guidelines of the crisis categories of the event. When an event belongs to more than one category, the corresponding guidelines are concatenated in the order in which the categories are listed. The comparison tests whether the guidelines have to be given explicitly at generation time, or whether fine-tuning on the data is enough for the model to infer them. Further details on the settings and on the hyperparameters are given in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 我们用两种配置训练模型。 在平原设置中,用户提示仅包含事件描述. 另一方面,在"+指针"设置中,"快取"还额外包含了该事件危机类别被翻译的FEMA指南. 当一个事件属于一个以上类别时,相应的指南会按照列出类别的先后顺序来整理. 比较检验的是,是否必须在一代人的时间明确给出准则,或者对数据进行微调是否足以使模型推断出这些准则。 关于设置和超参数的进一步详情见附录A。

blocks.en: Table 3: ROUGE-L F1 (R-L), BLEU (B) and BERTScore F1 (BS) on the test split, per configuration, temperature and language. Bold marks the best temperature within each block. Zero-shot uses the un-finetuned Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with identical configuration.
blocks.zh: 表3:测试分拆上的ROUGE-L F1(R-L),BLEU(B)和BERTScore F1(BS),每个配置,温度和语言. 粗体标出每个街区内最好的温度. 零射出使用配置相同的无纤维Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.

blocks.en:
After training, we generated warning messages for the 100 test events in all five languages, in both configurations and at five decoding temperatures (1.0, 0.8, 0.6, 0.4 and 0.2), to assess the trade-off between output variety and conformity to the crisis guidelines. As a baseline, we also ran the same generations with the off-the-shelf model in a zero-shot setting, using the same prompt as in training.
In order to measure the effect of fine-tuning and of the decoding temperature, all generations were evaluated against the reference messages with two overlap metrics, ROUGE-L and BLEU, and with BERTScore, which is a semantic metric based on contextual embeddings. These scores were then used to select the data included in the human study.
More information on the metrics is given in Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
经过培训,我们以所有5种语言,以两种配置和5个解码温度(1.0、0.8、0.6、0.4和0.2)为100次测试活动发出警告信息,以评估产出种类与符合危机准则之间的取舍。 作为基线,我们也在零射入场的情况下运行着与现成模型相同的世代,使用与训练时相同的快取.
为了衡量微调和解码温度的影响,根据参考信息对所有几代人进行了评价,采用了两个相重叠的度量衡,即ROUGE-L和BLEU,以及BERTScore,这是一个基于上下文嵌入的语义计量. 这些分数随后被用来选择人类研究中包含的数据.
关于衡量尺度的更多信息见附录B。

blocks.en:
Since automatic metrics are only a proxy for the quality of a warning message, we complemented them with a human preference study.
On the basis of the automatic evaluation we restricted the study to the three best-performing decoding temperatures.
For each of the two training configurations, one native speaker per language was presented with 50 test event-message pairs in their own language, each accompanied by the three corresponding generations. The two configurations were annotated separately, and the three candidates were shown anonymized, without any indication of the temperature that distinguished them. Annotators were asked to choose the message they considered grammatically better and more compliant with the task, and could leave free-text comments to motivate the choice or report problems the selection alone could not express. At the end of the annotation, we also asked which of the two configurations they preferred overall.
blocks.zh:
由于自动度量衡只是警示信息质量的代名词,我们用人类偏好研究来补充.
在自动评估的基础上,我们把研究限制在三个性能最好的解码温度.
两种训练组合中,每种语言各有一个母语演讲者,用自己的语言为50个测试事件信息配对,每个配对都有三个相应的代相伴. 两种配置分别附加了说明,三位候选人被显示为无名化,没有说明区分他们的温度. 请注释者选择他们认为语法上更好、更符合任务的信息,并且可以留下自由文字评论来激励选择或报告选择本身无法表达的问题。 在注释结尾,我们还问他们总体上喜欢哪一种配置.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: This section reports what the experiments described in Section 4 indicate about the resource. The automatic evaluation serves two purposes: it establishes whether fine-tuning on the resource is necessary, and it narrows the set of decoding temperatures presented to the annotators. The human preference study then addresses what the metrics cannot capture, namely whether the generations are appropriate in each language and which of the two training configurations should be preferred.
blocks.zh: 本节报告第4节所描述的实验表明的资源情况。 自动评价有两个目的:它确定是否有必要对资源进行微调,并收缩向注释者提出的一套解码温度. 然后,人类偏好研究将探讨衡量标准无法掌握的内容,即每一语言中世代是否合适,以及两种培训组合中哪一种应优先。

blocks.en: 5.1 Automatic Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.1 自动评价

blocks.en: Table 3 reports ROUGE-L, BLEU and BERTScore on the test split for each language and decoding temperature, in the two training configurations and in the corresponding baselines. The comparison is intended as intra-language, across temperatures and configurations. All three metrics are sensitive to language-specific factors such as tokenization and morphology, so inter-language differences do not indicate a quality ranking.
blocks.zh: 表3报告ROUGE-L、BLEU和BERTScore在两种培训配置和相应基线中对每种语言进行测试分解并解码温度。 比较的用意是语言内部的,跨温度和配置的. 所有三个度量衡都对语言特定因素如道具和形态等敏感,因此语言间差异并不表示质量排名.

blocks.en:
The fine-tuned models score higher than the baseline on all three metrics in every language, temperature and prompt configuration.
ROUGE-L and BLEU reward two aspects of a generation at once, its length and its wording. BLEU keeps them separate, as the product of the brevity penalty and the n-gram precision term.
As Table 4 shows, at T = 0.2 T=0.2 the fine-tuned models match the length of the human references, while the baseline with the plain prompt produces little more than half of the 300 characters. The table also reports BLEU without the brevity penalty: the n-gram precision term rises from .114 to .177, so fine-tuning also improves the wording.
Adding the guidelines to the baseline prompt recovers part of the length gap, but the gain is small compared to fine-tuning and the n-gram precision term does not improve (.114 to .104).
BERTScore shows the same pattern: at T = 0.2 T{=}0.2 fine-tuning raises it from .892 to .916, while adding the guidelines to the baseline prompt leaves it virtually unchanged (.891).
Therefore, these results indicate that fine-tuning on this data contributes substantially to both the length and the wording of the generations, and we restrict the rest of the evaluation to the fine-tuned models.
blocks.zh:
微调模型在每种语言,温度和即时配置中,所有三个度量的分数都高于基线.
ROUGE-L和BLEU同时奖励一代人的两个方面,长度和用词. BLEU保持它们分开,作为简洁度罚和正克精度术语的产物.
如表4所示,在T=0.2 T=0.2时,微调模型与人类参考文献的长度相匹配,而与平地快取的基线则产生出300个字符中略多于一半. 该表还报告BLEU没有简洁的处罚:n克精准名词从.114升至.177,因此微调也改善了措辞.
将准则添加到基线即时恢复部分长度差距,但与微调相比收益很小,正克精准值没有改善(.114至.104).
BERTScore显示同样的模式:在T = 0.2 T{=}0.2微调时,将它从892提高到了916,同时在基线快报中添加了指针使其几乎保持不变(.891)。
因此,这些结果表明,对这些数据的微调大大地促进了各代人的长度和措辞,我们把其他评价局限于微调模型。

blocks.en:
Table 4: Mean generation length in characters and BLEU without the brevity
penalty (BP), at T = 0.2 T{=}0.2 , over all five languages, for the zero-shot (ZS)
and fine-tuned (FT) models. Per-language values are in Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
表4:字符和BLEU的平均生成长度,不简洁
罚 (BP),按T=0.2 T{=}0.2,对所有五种语言,为零发(ZS)
和精细(FT)模型。 每种语言的数值载于附录B。

blocks.en:
Across all setups, zero-shot and fine-tuned alike, scores rise as temperature decreases.
This pattern reflects the fact that lower temperatures sharpen the probability around the most likely sequence, yielding wording that is less likely to include rare or unexpected choices, and thus closer to the reference text (which these metrics reward by construction). Whether such messages are also better is assessed in the human study (Section 5.2 ).
When results are pooled across languages, both ROUGE-L and BLEU increase in a strictly monotonic way from temperature 1.0 down to 0.2. BERTScore does the same, except for a tie between 0.4 and 0.2 in the fine-tuned +guidelines configuration (.914). At the language level, however, the trend holds but is not always monotonic: in the +guidelines configuration, for example, ROUGE-L for English and BLEU for German are marginally lower at 0.2 than at 0.4. In fine-tuned models these deviations are less relevant, never exceeding .005.
blocks.zh:
在所有设定中, 零镜头和微调相同, 得分随温度下降而上升。
这种模式反映了一个事实,即更低的温度使最可能的序列周围的概率变小,产生的措辞不太可能包括罕见或出乎意料的选择,从而更接近参考文本(这些衡量标准通过构建而奖励了参考文本). 在人类研究中也评估这种信息是否更好(第5.2节)。
在各种语言之间汇集结果时,ROUGE-L和BLEU均以严格单调的方式从温度1.0降低到0.2. BERTScore也这样做,除了在微调后+导线配置(914)中有一个0.4到0.2的平分. 然而,在语言层面,趋势是维持但并不总是单一的:例如,在+指针配置中,英语的ROUGE-L和德语的BLEU略低于0.2。 在微调模型中,这些偏差的相关性较低,不超过.005.

blocks.en: The two training configurations are close to each other. In the 0.6-0.2 range, ROUGE-L and BLEU favor the +guidelines configuration for English and Greek, while the plain configuration is better on Italian. On German the two are close, with the plain configuration slightly ahead at temperature 0.2. Bulgarian is the only language where the two overlap metrics disagree: at the two lowest temperatures the plain configuration is ahead on BLEU and the +guidelines one on ROUGE-L. BERTScore separates the two configurations even less, with differences of at most .003 in every language in this range, and does not reproduce the advantage of the guidelines on English and Greek. Considering the aggregated metrics over all languages, the two configurations are virtually identical. No configuration is consistently better, so the automatic metrics do not settle which configuration to prefer, motivating the human evaluation described in Section 5.2 .
blocks.zh: 两个训练配置相近. 在0.6-0.2范围内,ROUGE-L和BLEU倾向于英语和希腊语的+取向配置,而平面配置则优于意大利语. 在德文上,两者相距相近,平面配置在0.2温下略为领先. 保加利亚语是唯一两个相重叠的度量标准有分歧的语言:在两种最低温度下,平面配置在BLEU上领先,而+指向1在ROUGE-L上. BERTScore将两种配置分离得更少,在这个范围内每种语言的差异最多为.003个,不重复英语和希腊语准则的优势. 考虑到所有语文的汇总指标,两种配置基本相同。 任何配置都无法持续改善,因此自动衡量标准无法确定哪个配置更可取,从而推动第5.2节所述的人类评价。

blocks.en: Based on the automatic scores, we focused on temperatures 0.6, 0.4 and 0.2 for the human evaluation.
blocks.zh: 基于自动分数,我们注重温度为0.6,0.4和0.2进行人类评价.

blocks.en: 5.2 Human Preference Study
blocks.zh: 5.2 人类优先研究

blocks.en:
The automatic scores rank the temperatures consistently, but they do not indicate which generation a reader would prefer, and they do not separate the two training configurations.
We therefore asked one native speaker per language, with expertise in crisis communication, to compare the three generations and to select the one they considered most natural, grammatical and consistent with the task.
The annotation covered 50 test events, with the candidates generated at temperatures 0.6, 0.4 and 0.2, and was repeated for both training configurations. When no candidate was acceptable, the annotator could leave the item unannotated.
blocks.zh:
自动分数对温度进行一致排序,但没有说明读者喜欢哪一代,也没有将两种训练配置分开.
因此,我们要求每个语言都有一个具有危机沟通专门知识的本地发言者来比较这三代人,并选择他们认为最自然、语法和符合任务的人。
注释涵盖50起测试事件,考生在0.6,0.4和0.2等温度下产生,并被重复用于两个训练配置. 如果无法接受任何候选人,注释员可以对该项目不作说明。

blocks.en: Table 5: Preference counts per configuration and language. N N is the number of annotated events out of 50.
blocks.zh: 表5:每个配置和语言的首选数。 N N是50个被注解事件的数量.

blocks.en:
Table 5 shows that temperature 0.2 receives the most preferences in all five languages and in both training configurations, although the trend is not uniformly evident in all cases (e.g., for the +guidelines model).
In Bulgarian, the generations using the guidelines led to the rejection of all three candidates in 13 items because of errors in the generated text.
In the plain configuration a choice was always made, although the comments indicate that some candidates were still flawed. Lastly, Greek in the +guidelines configuration shows the smallest margin in the table, with only two preferences separating temperature 0.2 and 0.4, so the annotation does not indicate a clear preference between them.
blocks.zh:
表5显示,温度0.2在所有五种语言和两种训练配置中都得到了最优的偏好,尽管趋势并非在所有情况下都一致地明显(例如,对于+指针模型).
在保加利亚语中,几代人使用准则导致13个项目的所有3名候选人都因生成的案文有错误而被否决.
在平面配置中,总是作出选择,尽管评论表明,一些候选人仍然有缺陷。 最后,+指针配置中的希腊语显示表中最小的比值,只有两个偏好将温度0.2和0.4分开,因此注释没有表明它们之间的明显偏好.

blocks.en:
At the end of the task, each annotator also indicated which of the two models they preferred overall. All chose the plain model except the Greek annotator, who preferred the +guidelines one. The Italian annotator reported the plain model to have a better use of terminology and more specific warnings about the event, and the German annotator a better quality of the German text and slightly more accurate warning messages. Similarly, the English annotator motivated the preference with the accuracy of the messages, although reporting a narrower difference between the two models. The Bulgarian annotator’s justification was negative, referring to the amount of non-compliant content produced by the +guidelines model. On the other hand, the Greek annotator described the +guidelines generations as clearer, better structured and more effective in conveying urgency.
ROUGE-L and BLEU favor +guidelines in the 0.6-0.2 range only for Greek and English, matching the Greek annotator but not the English one, while BERTScore does not separate the two configurations in either language.
blocks.zh:
在任务结束时,每个注释员也指出他们总体上喜欢的两种模型中的哪一种. 所有人都选择了平原模型,除了希腊的注释者,他更喜欢"+指向"一. 意大利注释员报告说,平庸的模式是更好地使用术语,对事件提出更具体的警告,而德国注释员的德文文本质量更佳,警告信息略为准确. 同样,英国的注释员也促使人们倾向于信息准确性,尽管报告两种模式之间的差异较小。 保加利亚的注释员的理由是否定的,指的是+指针模型产生的不符合规定的内容的数量. 另一方面,希腊的注释者将"+指向"几代人描述为更清晰,更有条理,更有效地传达了紧迫性.
ROUGE-L和BLEU偏好 + guidelines在0.6-0.2范围内只针对希腊语和英语,匹配了希腊语的注释器而不是英语的注释器,而BERTScore则不会在两种语言中将两种配置分开.

blocks.en:
In addition to the preference judgment, annotators could leave free-text comments. These were optional and used to different extents, so they are reported as qualitative evidence rather than as a systematic annotation. They point to a difference between the two configurations that the automatic metrics do not capture.
The Greek, Italian and English annotators motivated their choices based on the wording of the warning and the appropriateness of the recommended actions.
In Greek these reasons differ between the two configurations: the plain model was chosen for its simpler wording and calmer tone, the +guidelines model for the specificity of its information and of the recommended actions.
In Bulgarian and German the comments instead report defects in the generations, most frequently grammatical errors and unfinished text. These are concentrated on the +guidelines model, consistent with the overall preference for the plain configuration reported above. None of these problems is visible in the automatic scores, and this is where the human study contributes most.
blocks.zh:
除了偏好判断外,注释者还可以留下自由文本的评论. 这些是可选的,在不同程度上使用,因此被报告为定性证据,而不是系统性的说明。 它们指出了自动度量衡无法捕捉的两种配置的区别.
希腊、意大利和英国的注解员促使他们根据警告的措辞和所建议的行动的适当性作出选择。
在希腊语中,这两个构型的这些原因不同:平原模型选取其更简洁的措辞和更平和的语气,+指针模型选取其信息的特殊性和建议的行动.
在保加利亚文和德文中,评论反而报告了几代人的缺陷,最常见的是语法错误和未完成的案文。 这些都集中在+指向模型上,与上文所述的平面配置的总体偏好一致. 这些问题在自动分数中都看不出来,这是人类研究贡献最大的.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Our experiments show that fine-tuning on CrisiLangs yields a single model that produces warning messages in all five languages, above the baseline in the automatic evaluation, but the human study suggests that quality is not uniform across languages. For English, Italian, German and Greek, the annotators expressed a preference for almost every item, and their comments mostly point to specific flaws rather than to unusable generations.
By contrast, with the Bulgarian plain model a choice could always be made, even when candidates were non-compliant or contained errors. With the +guidelines model, 13 items were left unannotated because none of the three candidates was acceptable.
The resource therefore supports warning generation in all five languages, with the Bulgarian +guidelines output being less reliable, mostly for limitations of the LLM.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验显示,对克瑞西朗斯的微调产生一个单一的模型,以所有五种语言生成警告信息,高于自动评价的基线,但人类的研究表明,各语言的质量并不一致. 对于英语,意大利语,德语和希腊语,注释者表示倾向于几乎每个项目,他们的评论大多指出具体的缺陷,而不是无法使用的世代.
相比之下,与保加利亚的平庸模式相比,即使候选人不符合规定或存在错误,也总是可以作出选择。 采用+指针模式,有13个项目未加说明,因为三个候选人都无法接受。
因此,该资源支持以所有五种语言生成警告,保加利亚语+指针输出的可靠性较低,主要用于LLM的限制.

blocks.en: Across the five languages we evaluated, low decoding temperatures are consistently preferred. The automatic metrics increase as the temperature decreases, as they favor wording closer to the reference by construction, so the more informative evidence comes from the human study: among the three temperatures compared, 0.2 receives the most preferences in all languages and in both training configurations (Table 5 ). Since annotators were asked to judge grammaticality and compliance with the task, this indicates that they found lower-temperature messages better on these criteria. The pattern holds in both the plain and the +guidelines configuration, so it does not depend on having the guidelines in the prompt. For practical use of this resource, low temperatures appear to be the safer choice.
blocks.zh: 在我们评价的五种语言中,低解码温度一直很受欢迎。 自动测量值随着温度的降低而增加,因为它们倾向于使用更接近建筑参考的措词,因此更翔实的证据来自人类研究:在所比较的三种温度中,0.2在所有语言和两种训练配置中都得到了最优的偏好(表5). 由于要求注释者判断语法和对任务的遵守情况,这表明他们发现较低温度的信息更符合这些标准. 该图案在平原和+指针配置中都同时存在,因此并不依赖于有指针在即时. 为了实际利用这一资源,低温似乎是更安全的选择。

blocks.en:
The effect of the guidelines in the prompt is less uniform. Four of the five annotators preferred the plain model overall, citing better wording and more relevant content, and only the Greek annotator preferred the +guidelines one, for its clarity and structure.
These preferences, together with the automatic metrics (where neither configuration is consistently ahead), suggest that in-prompt guidelines are not consistently beneficial. One possible explanation is that fine-tuning on the gold messages already induces much of the intended compliance, making the guidelines largely redundant; moreover, adding a long block of instructions increases prompt length and can dilute attention to the event-specific details, which may ultimately hurt generation quality.
blocks.zh:
准则在即时效果不太统一。 5个注释者中有4个总体上倾向于平庸模式,引用了更好的措辞和更具相关性的内容,只有希腊注释者倾向于+指针一,因为其清晰度和结构.
这些偏好,加上自动衡量标准(两者都不一贯地领先),表明即时准则并非始终有益。 一种可能的解释是,对黄金信息的微调已经诱发了许多预定的遵守,使准则在很大程度上变得多余;此外,增加一长块指示会增加迅速的长度并会淡化对事件具体细节的注意,这最终会损害生成质量.

blocks.en: A final observation concerns the relation between the two evaluations. The automatic metrics rank the temperatures consistently, but none of them, BERTScore included, anticipates the Bulgarian result: in Table 3 the +guidelines scores for Bulgarian are close to the plain ones at every temperature, yet the annotator found none of the three candidates acceptable in 13 of the 50 items in that configuration and in none of the plain ones. Human validation therefore remains necessary when crisis warning generation is extended to new languages.
blocks.zh: 最后一点涉及两项评价之间的关系。 自动测量标准对温度进行一致的排序,但其中没有一个(包括BERTScore)预测保加利亚的结果:在表3中,保加利亚人的+指导分数在每个温度下都接近平地分数,然而,注释者发现,在该组合的50个项目中,有13个项目中,没有13个项目是可接受的,没有1个项目是平地分数。 因此,在将危机预警生成扩大到新语言时,人类验证仍然是必要的。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We presented CrisiLangs , a multilingual extension of CrisiText to Italian, Bulgarian, German, and Greek.
The resource contains 1,000 events from 411 scenarios, with human-translated warning messages in four languages alongside the original English ones, for a total of 5,000 event-message pairs.
blocks.zh:
我们向CrisiLangs介绍了CrisiText的多语种扩展,包括意大利语、保加利亚语、德语和希腊语。
资源包含来自411场情景的1000个事件,与原始英语同时发布的由人翻译的警告信息,共5000个事件信息对.

blocks.en:
To benchmark this resource we fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on the five languages and compared it with a zero-shot baseline.
We evaluated the generations in the five languages both with automatic metrics and with a human preference study.
We observed that, compared to the baseline, fine-tuning improved ROUGE-L, BLEU and BERTScore in every language and prompt configuration (with or without guidelines).
Lower decoding temperatures lead to higher automatic scores, which can be expected from reference-based metrics, this is then confirmed by the annotators where the temperature 0.2 received the most preferences in all five languages and in both configurations.
blocks.zh:
为了确定这一资源的基准,我们对五种语言的Llama-3.1-8B-Instructiont进行了微调,并将其与零射入基线进行比较。
我们用五种语言来评价这几代人,同时使用自动测量和人类偏好研究。
我们注意到,与基线相比,改进了每种语言的ROUGE-L、BLEU和BERTScore,并迅速配置(有或没有指导方针)。
更低的解码温度会导致更高的自动分数,这可以从基于参考的度量衡中预期得到,然后得到所有五种语言和两种配置中最偏好温度0.2的注释员的确认.

blocks.en:
The human evaluation suggests that providing the emergency guidelines to the model during generation does not reliably improve the output: four of the five annotators preferred the plain configuration overall, and only the Greek annotator preferred the configuration with guidelines.
In our evaluation, the automatic metrics did not reveal the problems found by the annotators: the Bulgarian +guidelines generations score close to the plain ones, yet in 13 of the 50 items none of the candidates was acceptable. This points to the importance of expert native-speaker assessment when benchmarking warning message generation.
blocks.zh:
人类评价认为,在生成期间为模型提供应急指导方针并不能可靠地改善产出:五个注释者中有四个人更喜欢整体平面配置,只有希腊注释者更喜欢有指导方针的配置.
在我们的评价中,自动衡量标准没有揭示注释者发现的问题:保加利亚人+指导线的几代人得分接近平庸人,然而在50个项目中的13个项目中,没有一个候选人是可以接受的。 这表明,在编制预警信息基准时,专家母语评估十分重要。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: In the current setup the model receives the event in the target language and generates the warning message in the same language, so automatic translation is used only on the input side. The resource also supports feeding the model the English event directly and generating the message in the target language in a single pass, removing automatic translation from the pipeline entirely, but we do not evaluate this setting, as it would require a further round of automatic and human evaluation.
blocks.zh: 在当前设置中,模型以目标语言接收事件并生成同一种语言的警告消息,因此自动翻译只用于输入侧. 资源还支持直接为模型提供英语事件,并以一通单行本生成目标语言的信息,完全去掉管道中的自动翻译,但我们不评估这种设置,因为这需要再进行一轮自动和人性评价.

blocks.en:
A second limitation is that we focus on fine-tuning a single multilingual model. Complementary comparisons (e.g., comparisons with language-specific pretrained LLMs, particularly for Greek and Bulgarian, which use non-Latin scripts, and with a model fine-tuned exclusively on English data to assess the added value of target-language supervision) are natural next steps that we leave to future work.
Translation and preference annotation were carried out by a single native speaker per language, reflecting the specialized expertise required for crisis communication. Future work with additional annotators would enable measuring inter-annotator agreement; nonetheless, the preference for temperature 0.2 is shared by all five annotators.
blocks.zh:
第二个局限性是,我们侧重于微调单一多语种模式。 补充性比较(例如,与语言特定、事先受过培训的LLMs的比较,特别是希腊语和保加利亚语使用非拉丁字母的LLMs,以及完全根据英语数据进行精细调整的模型,以评估目标语言监督的附加价值)是我们留给未来工作的自然步骤。
每种语言的翻译和首选说明由一名当地人作,反映了危机沟通所需的专门知识。 今后与更多注释员合作,将可衡量注释员之间的协议;不过,所有五个注释员都倾向于使用0.2温度。

blocks.en:
Finally, the resource provides 1,000 expert-reviewed event-message pairs per language; by comparison, CrisiText contains more than 100,000 English pairs, as our extension focuses on the expert-reviewed subset.
Human translation was also limited to the warning messages: the messages are what the model produces and what the annotators judge, whereas the events and guidelines only enter as input. Translation noise on the input side therefore remains in the data.
blocks.zh:
最后,资源提供每种语言1000个专家审查事件的信息对;相比之下,CrisiText包含超过10万个英文对子,因为我们的扩展侧重于专家审查子集.
人文翻译也仅限于警告信息:信息是模型生成的,是注释者判断的,而事件和准则仅作为投入输入. 因此,输入方的翻译噪音仍留在数据中。

blocks.en: Appendix A Hyperparameters and Generation Settings
blocks.zh: 附录 A 超参数和生成设置

blocks.en: We fine-tuned meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with a peft LoRA adapter: rank 16 16 , alpha 16 16 , dropout 0 0 , no bias adaptation, task type CAUSAL_LM . The adapter targets q_proj , k_proj , v_proj , o_proj , gate_proj , up_proj and down_proj . The base model was loaded in bfloat16 without quantization, and the adapter was merged back into the base weights before generation.
blocks.zh: 校对:Soup 适配器瞄准了 q_proj., k_proj. v_proj., o_proj. gate_proj. up_proj and down_proj. 基座模型被装入bfloat16而未被分解出,适配器在生成前被再被合并入基座重量.

blocks.en: Training used trl ’s SFTTrainer . Sequences were capped at 1024 1024 tokens; the learning rate was 3 ​ e − 4 3\mathrm{e}{-4} with a cosine schedule, weight decay 0.01 0.01 and warmup ratio 0.03 0.03 . We used a batch size of 2 2 for training and 4 4 for evaluation, with gradients accumulated over 4 4 steps, for an effective batch size of 8 8 . We ran for up to 10 10 epochs, evaluating and checkpointing every 50 50 steps with early stopping patience 5 5 , and kept the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss. Data were shuffled with seed 42 42 and the trainer ran with seed 0 0 . The two configurations differ only in the prompt: plain receives the instruction and the chain of events, +guidelines additionally receives the localized guideline blocks. Both were trained with the same hyperparameters on the same 4,000 4{,}000 training examples.
blocks.zh: SFTtrainer的训练。 顺序被封为1024个1024个令牌;学习率为3 e – 4 3\ mathrm{e}{-4},并有同位素时间表,重量衰减0.01 0.01和热量比为0.03 0.03. 我们使用2个批量规模用于培训,4个批量规模用于评价,梯度累积在4个步骤以上,有效批量规模为8个8个。 我们跑了多达10个10个纪元,每50个步骤评估和检查一次,并及早停止耐心5个5个,使检查站的验证损失最低。 数据以42号种子被洗牌,教练以0号种子被洗牌. 两种配置仅在快取上有所不同:平取指令和事件链,+指针还取本地化的准则块. 在4 000个4{,} 000个培训实例上,他们都接受了同样的超参数培训。

blocks.en: Padding used Llama-3.1’s <|finetune_right_pad_id|> on the right, and turns were formatted with the Llama-3.1 chat template.
blocks.zh: Padding在右侧使用Llama-3.1's QQQ finetune_right_pad_id_|>,并用Llama-3.1聊天模板来格式化转弯.

blocks.en: Decoding used sampling with a top-p of 1 1 and a cap of 128 128 new tokens, sufficient for a warning message. Each test prompt was decoded once per temperature ( 1 1 , 0.8 0.8 , 0.6 0.6 , 0.4 0.4 , 0.2 0.2 ), giving 2,500 2{,}500 generations per model configuration ( 100 100 test records × \times 5 5 languages × \times 5 5 temperatures).
blocks.zh: 解码使用取样,顶端为11个P,顶端为128个128个新信使,足以发出警告信息. 每个测试提示被解码一次每个温度(1 1,0.8 0.8,0.6 0.6,0.4 0.4,0.2 0.2),给出2500 2{,}每个模型配置的500代(100 100个测试记录 ×\times 5 5 个语言 ×\time 5 个温度).

blocks.en: The zero-shot baseline was the same meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct without the LoRA adapter, and was run over the same test split with the same prompts, the same five temperatures and the same decoding arguments and post-processing.
blocks.zh: 零射入基线是没有LORA适配器的同元-拉玛/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct,运行在同一个测试分出相同的导出,相同的5个温度和相同的解码参数和后处理.

blocks.en: All fine-tuning and generation runs were performed on a single NVIDIA A40 GPU.
blocks.zh: 所有微调和生成运行均由单NVIDIA A40 GPU进行.

blocks.en: Appendix B Automatic Metrics
blocks.zh: 附录B 自动计量

blocks.en: For automatic metrics we used Hugging Face’s evaluate library ( evaluate 0.4.6 0.4.6 , rouge-score 0.1.2 0.1.2 , nltk 3.10.2 3.10.2 ) for ROUGE, sacrebleu 2.6.0 2.6.0 for BLEU, and bert-score 0.3.13 0.3.13 ( transformers 4.57.6 4.57.6 ) for BERTScore, all computed per language, configuration and temperature.
blocks.zh: 对于自动度量衡,我们使用Hugging Face的评价库(评价0.4.6 0.4.6, Rouge-score 0.1.2 0.1.2,nltk 3.10.2 3.10.2)用于ROUGE,sacrebleu 2.6.0 2.6.0用于BLEU,bert-score 0.3.13 0.3.13 (变压器 4.57.6 4.57.6)用于BERTScore,均按语言、配置和温度计算。

blocks.en: is the F1 of the longest common subsequence, computed over the message as a single token sequence, and aggregated as the median of 1,000 1{,}000 bootstrap resamples. rouge_score ’s default tokenizer lowercases and keeps only Latin letters and digits, discarding all Cyrillic and Greek characters: with this configuration only about 2 % 2\% of Bulgarian and 5 % 5\% of Greek reference tokens survive, and what remains is digits and Latin-script names. We therefore passed a Unicode-aware tokenizer, so that all five languages are scored on their own scripts.
blocks.zh: 是最长的普通子序列中的F1,在信件中作为单一的符号序列计算,并被集合为1000 1{,}000个靴子后缀的中位数. rouge_score的默认代号小写并只保留拉丁字母和数字,丢弃了所有的西里尔字母和希腊字母:这个配置只有约2%的保加利亚字母和5%的希腊参考符号存活下来,剩下的是数字和拉丁字母名称。 因此,我们通过了一个Unicode-aware的标注器,以便所有五种语言都在其自己的脚本上得分.

blocks.en: was computed at corpus level with SacreBLEU’s default settings 5 5 5 Signature: nrefs:1|case:mixed|eff:no|tok:13a|smooth:exp|version:2.6.0 , including the script-agnostic 13a tokenizer. Scores were divided by 100 100 to match the 0 0 – 1 1 scale of the other metrics.

was computed with xlm-roberta-large for all five languages, without idf weighting and without baseline rescaling, as no rescaling baseline is available for Bulgarian and Greek. Each reported score is the mean of the per-item F1 scores. Without rescaling, all scores in Table 3 fall between .865 and .925, so BERTScore differences are small in absolute terms and should only be compared within its own columns.
blocks.zh: 由于保加利亚语和希腊语没有缩放基线,因此是用所有五种语言的xlm-roberta-大来计算,不带边框加权和基线缩放。 每个已报告的分数是每个项目F1分数的平均值. 不进行分级调整,表3中的所有分数都从865分到925分之间,所以BERTScore的分数绝对值相差不大,只应在自己的分行内进行比较.

blocks.en: All reported scores were computed on CPU directly from the released generation files.
blocks.zh: 所有报告的分数都是直接从已发布的生成文件在CPU上计算的.

blocks.en: Appendix C Human Annotations
blocks.zh: 附录C

blocks.en: The annotators were members of organizations engaged in crisis management, selected if native speakers in the target language and according to their professional experience. For the translation and annotation work, annotators were compensated fairly by their respective organizations in compliance with applicable national laws.
blocks.zh: 注释员是从事危机管理的组织的成员,如果是使用目标语言并根据其专业经验选择的当地人的话。 就翻译和注释工作而言,注释员得到各自组织根据适用的国家法律给予的公平补偿。

blocks.en: For each language and each of the two model configurations, annotators compared the outputs of the three best-scoring temperatures ( 0.6 0.6 , 0.4 0.4 , 0.2 0.2 ) on 50 50 test events. The three outputs were presented as blind candidate A/B/C, and annotators selected one candidate per event and could optionally leave a free-text comment.
blocks.zh: 对于每种语言和两种模型配置中的每一种,注释者比较了50个测试事件的三个得分最高的温度(0.6,0.4,0.4,0.2)的输出. 三项产出是作为盲目的候选人A/B/C提出的,注释员每次选取一名候选人,可以选择留下自由文字评论。
